proxy_interface.PURPOSE: Authenticate one fixed ordinary READ_PROXY role/session on approved isolated TEST server
proxy_interface.PROTOCOL: Existing PostgreSQL role/session authentication plus independently enrolled local proxy endpoint; no Package wrapper key substitution
proxy_interface.ISSUER: DEPLOYMENT external provisioning under approved role/endpoint manifest
proxy_interface.SUBJECT: Exact fixed READ_PROXY principal and enrolled proxy process
proxy_interface.CUSTODIAN: Proxy only; participants receive signed nonsecret snapshot, no SQL handle
proxy_interface.DELIVERY: Pre-enrollment protected capability channel; no caller-selected role/endpoint/auth data
proxy_interface.AUTHENTICATION: Future mechanism must independently bind authenticated SQL session role+server endpoint+proxy birth identity to exact manifest, reject caller choice of user=postgres or alternate server; no ambient trust
proxy_interface.AUTHORITY: Only exact approved read projection, no role/owner/SET/ADMIN privileges
proxy_interface.USE_COUNT: One session per snapshot challenge; reconnect retires session
proxy_interface.EXPIRY: Versioned positive bounded snapshot lease and generation continuity
proxy_interface.PERSISTENCE: No participant persistence; proxy private lifecycle only
proxy_interface.OBSERVER: Independent HEALTH_GUARD verifies SQL role/session/server binding and proxy process
proxy_interface.DESTRUCTION: Close session, revoke private transport; independent extinction receipt
